title: DarGlobal - About Us & Company Overview
text: DarGlobal (LSE: DAR) is a premier international luxury real estate developer established in 2017 as the international arm of Dar Al Arkan, one of Saudi Arabia's largest real estate developers. DarGlobal is listed on the London Stock Exchange and headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with regional offices in Dubai, Riyadh, Marbella, and Muscat. The company specializes in developing ultra-luxury, internationally branded residential properties and luxury hospitality destinations across prime global locations in the United Kingdom, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, and Saudi Arabia.

title: DarGlobal - Vision and Strategic Partnerships
text: DarGlobal focuses on the luxury second-home and international investor market. Its signature development philosophy pairs world-class architectural design with iconic luxury global brands. DarGlobal's prestigious global brand partners include Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani Automobili, Missoni, Elie Saab, Aston Martin, Marriott International (W Hotels), and The Trump Organization. These collaborations create bespoke, high-value residences that offer unparalleled lifestyle standards, luxury finishes, and distinctive brand aesthetics.

title: DarGlobal - DaVinci Tower by Pagani (Dubai Canal)
text: DaVinci Tower by Pagani is a residential masterpiece located directly on the Dubai Canal in Downtown Dubai. Developed by DarGlobal in collaboration with Italian supercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, it represents the world's first residential building with interiors entirely designed by Pagani. The tower features ultra-luxury 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments and lavish penthouses. Each residence incorporates Pagani's bespoke craftsmanship, carbon-fiber elements, customized Italian furniture, private elevators, and floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Canal.

title: DarGlobal - Urban Oasis by Missoni (Business Bay, Dubai)
text: Urban Oasis by Missoni is a luxury waterfront residential development by DarGlobal situated on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay. Designed in partnership with iconic Italian fashion house Missoni, the tower features stylish waterfront apartments ranging from studios to 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom luxury penthouses. The interior architecture captures Missoni's signature vibrant colors, zigzag patterns, and Italian design heritage. Amenities include an infinity swimming pool overlooking the canal, state-of-the-art fitness center, and private canal access.

title: DarGlobal - W Residences Dubai - Downtown
text: W Residences Dubai - Downtown is an elite branded residential tower developed by DarGlobal in the heart of Downtown Dubai, managed by Marriott International under the W Hotels brand. Standing tall with panoramic vistas of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain, the development offers 1, 2, 3-bedroom luxury apartments and exclusive penthouses. Residents enjoy W's signature Whatever/Whenever service, private clubhouse, infinity lap pool, screening room, fitness center, and direct proximity to Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera.

title: DarGlobal - DG1 Living (Business Bay, Dubai)
text: DG1 Living is an architectural landmark by DarGlobal located on the Dubai Canal in Business Bay. Crafted by world-renowned architect Gensler, the tower features an eye-catching dynamic facade with cascading lines. DG1 Living offers a curated collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom luxury apartments designed for modern cosmopolitan living, complete with private balconies, canal and Burj Khalifa views, a sky garden, infinity pool, and premium wellness facilities.

title: DarGlobal - The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin (Ras Al Khaimah)
text: The Astera is a luxury beachfront residential project by DarGlobal located on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, adjacent to the upcoming Wynn Al Marjan Island resort and casino. Featuring bespoke interiors crafted by British ultra-luxury automotive brand Aston Martin, The Astera provides 1, 2, and 3-bedroom beachside apartments and luxury beachfront villas. The residences combine British racing elegance, natural materials, private beach access, infinity pool, and spa facilities.

title: DarGlobal - Trump International Resort & Golf Club at Aida (Oman)
text: Aida is a premier mixed-use cliffside master-planned destination in Muscat, Oman, developed by DarGlobal. Perched 100 meters above the Gulf of Oman, Aida features Trump International Hotel Oman, an 18-hole championship Trump Golf Course, Trump Cliff Villas, and luxury branded residences. This multibillion-dollar development offers cliff-hanging luxury villas, boutique wellness retreats, private beaches, Michelin-starred dining, and breathtaking coastal mountain views.

title: DarGlobal - Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini (Spain)
text: Tierra Viva is an ultra-exclusive gated residential community in Benahavis, near Marbella on Spain's Costa del Sol, developed by DarGlobal in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini. Inspired by iconic Lamborghini super sports cars, Tierra Viva comprises 53 individual luxury villas across three architectural designs: Diamante (6 bedrooms), Zafiro (5 bedrooms), and Esmeralda (4 bedrooms). Features include multi-tiered private swimming pools, rooftop viewing terraces, private car galleries, and Mediterranean sea views.

title: DarGlobal - Marea, Interiors by Missoni (Cortesin, Spain)
text: Marea is an exclusive residential community on Spain's Costa del Sol developed by DarGlobal with interiors designed by Italian fashion house Missoni. Situated within the prestigious Finca Cortesin resort in Casares, Marea offers 2, 3, and 4-bedroom luxury residences overlooking the Mediterranean Sea and one of Europe's top championship golf courses. The development features Missoni Home styling, private infinity pools, landscaped gardens, and 24/7 concierge security.

title: DarGlobal - Les Vagues by Elie Saab (Qatar)
text: Les Vagues by Elie Saab is an ultra-luxury beachfront residential project by DarGlobal located on Qetaifan Island North in Lusail, Qatar. Featuring interior design by celebrated haute couture designer Elie Saab, the development includes 1, 2, and 3-bedroom sea-facing apartments with expansive glass balconies, bespoke Elie Saab furniture collections, infinity pools overlooking the Persian Gulf, a private fitness center, and landscaped waterfront promenades.

title: Wasalt - Saudi Arabia's Leading Real Estate Platform
text: Wasalt (wasalt.com) is a leading Saudi Arabian real estate marketplace platform affiliated with Dar Al Arkan. Wasalt provides a modern digital ecosystem for searching, buying, selling, and renting residential and commercial properties throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). The platform connects property seekers, tenants, individual owners, certified real estate brokers, and major real estate developers with verified property data and transparent transactions.

title: Wasalt - Property Types and City Coverage in Saudi Arabia
text: Wasalt covers major metropolitan areas and provinces across Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Mecca, Medina, and Abha. The platform categorizes listings into residential properties (villas, modern apartments, townhouses, residential lands, duplexes) and commercial properties (office spaces, retail stores, commercial land plots, warehouses). Every listing includes details on square footage, room counts, amenities, neighborhood highlights, and pricing.

title: Wasalt - Certified Listings and REGA Compliance
text: Wasalt prioritizes transparency and compliance with Saudi Arabian regulatory standards established by the General Authority for Real Estate (REGA). All listings on Wasalt are verified through official advertising licenses (Fal license), ensuring authentic property titles, accurate pricing, and authorized broker representation. This eliminates fraudulent listings and ensures secure real estate transactions for buyers and renters across the Kingdom.

title: Wasalt - Real Estate Auctions and Investment Services
text: Wasalt hosts digital real estate auctions, enabling individuals, institutional investors, and corporations to participate in transparent, regulated bidding for high-value real estate assets, land parcels, and commercial developments across Saudi Arabia. The auction platform provides comprehensive property prospectuses, legal deeds, appraisal reports, and seamless electronic deposit and bidding mechanisms.

title: Wasalt - Real Estate Financing and Mortgage Facilitation
text: Wasalt partners with leading Saudi banks and licensed financial institutions to offer real estate financing calculators and mortgage pre-approval services. Property seekers can estimate monthly installments, compare mortgage options, and apply for Sharia-compliant home financing directly through the Wasalt platform, streamlining the path to homeownership for Saudi citizens and residents.

title: Wasalt - Mobile App and Smart Search Features
text: The Wasalt mobile application is available on iOS and Android in both Arabic and English. It offers smart filters by price, location, property type, and furnishing status. Users can view high-definition property photos, 360-degree virtual tours, interactive map views displaying nearby schools, hospitals, and mosques, and initiate instant chat or direct calls with certified brokers.
